title: Slow To Pour
text:
Slow To Pour. In the description here at Amazon they specifically mention this dispenser can be used for syrup. It pours way too slow to be used with syrup. Just a tiny thin amount comes out of the spout which means it seems like it takes forever to get enough syrup poured.

I am sorry I bought this dispenser.
